questions.explanation: Perimeter = 4s = 80 → s = 20 m. Area = 20² = 400 m². Cost = 400 × 5 = ₹2,000.

questions.question: A classroom wall needs painting. It is 12 m × 4 m but has a door (2 m × 2 m) and a window (3 m × 1.5 m). Paintable area =
questions.explanation: Total wall = 12×4 = 48 m². Door = 2×2 = 4 m². Window = 3×1.5 = 4.5 m². Paintable = 48 − 4 − 4.5 = 39.5 m².

questions.question: A parallelogram-shaped plot: base=30 m, height=20 m. Cost of planting grass at ₹8 per m² =
A composite figure: rectangle (16×10 cm) with a right triangle cut from one corner (base=6, height=10 cm). Area remaining =
questions.explanation: Rectangle = 16×10 = 160 cm². Triangle = ½×6×10 = 30 cm². Remaining = 160 − 30 = 130 cm².

questions.question: Two rectangles: A (25 cm × 14 cm) and B (35 cm × 10 cm). Which has greater area?
options: Both have equal area (350 cm² each)
questions.explanation: A = 25×14 = 350 cm². B = 35×10 = 350 cm². Both equal at 350 cm². Different shapes can have the same area — equal perimeters or equal areas don't imply equal shapes.

questions.question: A floor (10 m × 8 m) has a rectangular carpet (6 m × 4 m) placed at the centre. Uncarpeted floor area =
questions.explanation: Floor = 10×8 = 80 m². Carpet = 6×4 = 24 m². Uncarpeted = 80 − 24 = 56 m².

questions.question: A rhombus has area 240 cm² and one diagonal = 24 cm. Other diagonal =
questions.explanation: Area = ½ × d₁ × d₂ → 240 = ½ × 24 × d₂ → 240 = 12d₂ → d₂ = 20 cm.

For the same perimeter (P = 40 cm), which shape has greater area: square or rectangle (20×0)?
options: Square (all sides equal) — always has the greatest area for a given perimeter among rectangles
questions.explanation: Square: side = 40/4 = 10 cm, area = 100 cm². Rectangle 20×0: area = 0. Among all rectangles with fixed perimeter, the square has the maximum area.

questions.question: A rectangle has the same area as a triangle (base=24 m, height=10 m). Rectangle length = 15 m. Rectangle breadth =
questions.explanation: Triangle area = ½×24×10 = 120 m². Rectangle: 15×b = 120 → b = 8 m.
